name: CasCPRF
aliases: CasCPRF (Cascaded Canonical Polyadic Tensorial Radiance Fields)
definition: A novel tensor decomposed radiance field representation that achieves better compactness than TensoRF to approximate a high-order radiance field feature volume by employing a cascaded scheme to separate frequencies across multiple scales.
summary: CasCPRF is a compact radiance field representation that uses cascaded tensor decomposition to separate frequencies across hierarchical levels, achieving superior compactness compared to TensoRF.
